items.name: theme
items.title: MRI semantic theme
items.description: The semantic colour extension the preset does not ship: info, warning and notable, each with a fill, an ink-on-fill and a readable ink. Import it next to tailwindcss in app/globals.css.

items.name: agent-rules
items.title: MRI UI rules for agents
items.description: The imperative rule set for anyone editing an MRI interface, human or agent. Install it and reference it from AGENTS.md.

items.name: format
items.title: Shared formatting
items.description: Number, date and label formatting: grouped counts, integers, compact notation, deltas and ISO-safe dates. Dependency-free, so it installs anywhere — and the one place a numeral's treatment should be decided.

items.name: taxonomy
items.title: Portable domain vocabulary
items.description: The IUCN tone and label tables, the bird and observation record types, and countryFlag computed from an ISO code. No fixtures and no data, which is what makes specimen-card installable.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox, Phosphor import corrected
items.description: The preset checkbox with its icon import moved to /dist/ssr. Depending on the bare preset name instead overwrites a consumer's corrected file with the createContext hazard, which is exactly what happened to the platform twice.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: The single chip component: two surfaces (flow 20px, overlay 22px), seven tones, mandatory scrims on photographs. A span, not the preset Badge, because Badge cannot be recoloured.

items.name: chip-audit
items.title: Chip audit
items.description: Measures every rendered chip and reports any outside the two allowed sizes. Drop it on a review route.

items.name: ui-audit
items.title: UI audit
items.description: The enforcement harness: six rules over class strings and stylesheets — spacing scale, hand-rolled chips, raw tables, colour literals, banned imports, unsanctioned CSS — with a baseline that may only shrink. Project-specific exemptions go in scripts/audit-ui.config.json, never in the script. Wire it into npm run verify.

items.name: spacing-audit
items.title: Spacing audit (deprecated)
items.description: Deprecated alias for ui-audit, kept so an existing install does not break. It installs the same file: the audit grew from one rule to six and the old name no longer describes it.

items.name: layout
items.title: Page layout primitives
items.description: PageContainer, PageHeader, SectionHeader and the specimen labels used to document a pattern. No dependencies: it is layout and text only.

items.name: patterns
items.title: Page patterns
items.description: Panel — the data card, with the title-carries-its-count header enforced rather than described — plus TableCard, DataRow, MetricCard, MetricStrip, StatusBadge, FilterSidebar, StatusPath, RecordChange, the data states and the skeletons. The compositions a route composes from.

items.name: specimen-card
items.title: Specimen and media cards
items.description: ObservationCard and BirdMediaCard, plus IucnChip. The reference implementation of the overlay rules: two scrimmed chips at most, media facts on the image and record facts in the body.
